plugins.description: 官方 DSH 内核补丁的数据化版本：10 条自包含补丁 + 自适应应用器（自己找安装位置、逐个备份、语法检查、一键回退），五种打法、零硬编码路径。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Official DSH core patches as data: ten patches plus an adaptive applier. Five ways to apply. DSH 1.5 only.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-patch-library

**The official DSH core patches, as data — and five ways to apply them.**

**官方 DSH 内核补丁的数据化版本 —— 10 条补丁，5 种打法。**

Ten self-contained patches for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` and `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, plus a small
applier that finds *your* DSH installation by itself. No hard-coded paths, no personal information
anywhere in this repository, no network access required.

十条自成体系的补丁，覆盖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 与 `@earendil-works/pi-ai`；配一个小巧的应用器，
它会**自己找到你的 DSH 安装位置**。零硬编码路径、仓库里没有任何个人信息、全程不需要联网。

> 🌐 **中文完整说明（推荐中文读者从这里开始）** → **[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)**
>
> 中文读者还应该看这两份：[`教程-安装与官方补丁` 里的补丁库章节](https://github.com/xiamubumu/dsh-context-reclaim/blob/main/tutorial-install-and-official-patches.zh-CN.md)
> 与 [给 agent 的中文提示词](PROMPT.zh-CN.md)。

> Built for `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.2** (the 1.5 line). Every patch records the exact
> sha256 of both the file it expects and the file it produces, so the applier can tell you
> `exact` / `applied` / `conflict` before it touches anything.

---

## Why this repository exists

Some fixes cannot be shipped as a plugin: they have to run *inside* an official file, in the middle
of a function that Cordis does not expose as a seam. Four of those fixes were already published as
plugins (`dsh-context-reclaim`, `dsh-capability-composer`, `dsh-composer-launcher`,
`dsh-aux-degrade`). The rest — plus the ones that only matter if you want the full set — live here,
as ordinary unified diffs that anyone can read, review, apply, revert, or regenerate.

Nothing here is a binary blob and nothing here is magic: `patches/<id>/change.diff` is a normal
patch, and `manifest.json` is the metadata that lets a script apply it safely and reversibly.

## The ten patches

| id | package → file | kind | size | restart | already handled by a plugin? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dsh-llm-writable-request` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +18 −1 | yes | **yes — `dsh-context-reclaim`** |
| `agent-loop-snapshot-prompt` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +97 −20 | yes | no |
| `llm-pi-ai-system-prompt` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +96 −54 | yes | no |
| `compaction-pruner` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +354 −14 | yes | no |
| `ui-renderer-turntail` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer` → `lib/client.js` | lines | +9 −1 | no | no |
| `ui-sidebar-wrap` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` → `lib/lib-client.js` | **regex** | +1 −1 | no | no |
| `session-format-v1-to-v2` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v1-to-v2` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +2 −1 | yes | no |
| `session-persistence-jsonl` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` → `lib/worker.cjs` | lines | +2 −1 | yes | no |
| `mcp-client` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +59 −6 | yes | no |
| `pi-ai-max-tokens-floor` | `@earendil-works/pi-ai` → `dist/api/simple-options.js` | lines | +11 −1 | yes | no |

Every patch has its own `patches/<id>/NOTES.md` with **what it changes, when you want it, how to
verify it, and what to do if it does not fit your build** — in English and Chinese.

`ui-sidebar-wrap` is a **regex** patch on purpose: the sidebar's class prefix is a build hash, so a
line diff would be invalidated by any rebuild. `patches/<id>/change.json` stores the pattern and its
explicit inverse.

## Five ways to apply them

Pick whichever matches how you like to work. All five are documented step by step in
[`docs/methods.md`](docs/methods.md) (Chinese: [`docs/methods.zh-CN.md`](docs/methods.zh-CN.md)).

| | method | command |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | script (recommended) | `node apply.mjs --check` then `node apply.mjs --apply --all` |
| **B** | `git apply` | `cd <pkg dir> && git apply -p1 <library>/patches/<id>/change.diff` |
| **C** | your own AI agent | paste the block from [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and let it do A or B for you |
| **D** | regenerate for your build | `node tools/make-patch.mjs --file <patched> --orig <pristine> --pkg <pkg> --rel <rel>` |
| **E** | revert | `node apply.mjs --revert --all`, or restore any `*.orig` by hand |

All ten diffs were verified with `git apply -p1 --check` inside the package directory, so method B
works on every one of them.

### Method A in full

```bash
node apply.mjs --list                 # what is in here
node apply.mjs --roots                # which DSH installations were found on this machine
node apply.mjs --check                # per-file state: exact / applied / conflict / missing
node apply.mjs --apply --all          # apply everything that fits
node apply.mjs --apply --only mcp-client,compaction-pruner
node apply.mjs --revert --all         # put every .orig backup back
```

`--check` reports one of:

| state | meaning |
|---|---|
| `exact` | the file is the pristine version this library was built from — applying is safe |
| `applied` | the file already equals the patched version, nothing to do |
| `variant` | same version, different build (hash differs) but the hunks still fit — needs `--allow-variant`, or method D |
| `conflict` | the hunks do not fit. **Nothing is written.** Use method D to regenerate for your build |
| `missing` | that package is not part of the installation that was found |

### What the applier guarantees

* **It finds your installation, it does not assume one.** `--root`, `$DSH_APP_ROOT`,
  `$DSH_INSTALL_ROOT`, `$DSH_HOME` (including `profiles/*`), the running process's own DSH path,
  a `node` resolution from the current directory, and a bounded scan of the usual install locations
  for Windows / macOS / Linux — see `lib/discover.mjs`. `--root` means *exactly* that root, never
  that root plus whatever else was found.
* **`.orig` is sacred.** A backup is written once, next to the file, and never overwritten. If a
  `.orig` already exists, it is reused.
* **Every edit is syntax-checked.** `node --check` runs after each write; on failure the backup is
  restored immediately and the patch is reported as failed.
* **A hunk that does not fit is a conflict, never a guess.** The engine matches a hunk's old side
  exactly, exactly once, near the position it was recorded at.
* **It only writes inside the resolved root.** Nothing under `$DSH_HOME` is touched except, if you
  explicitly point `--root` at a profile directory, that profile's own `node_modules` copy of a
  package.

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` a requested action failed or conflicted, `2` no installation found.

## If you already run the four DSH plugins

You can skip `dsh-llm-writable-request` — `dsh-context-reclaim` takes over that path from inside the
plugin, with the official patch reverted. `--check` says so explicitly:

```
= dsh-llm-writable-request     already    node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/index.js
    not needed: the dsh-context-reclaim plugin already handles this
```

The other nine are independent of the plugins: install neither, one, or both.

## Self-test

```bash
node verify.mjs
```

Offline, no DSH installation required. It checks that every diff parses and its hunk counts agree,
that the declared marker really is added by its patch, that the apply/revert engine round-trips on
synthetic samples, that a duplicated context is rejected instead of guessed, that the regex patch
round-trips through any class prefix — and that **no file in this repository contains a drive
letter, a personal home directory or a private workspace name** (that scan is part of the test
suite, not a promise).

`verify.mjs` finishes with a read-only `--check` summary of whatever installation it finds.

## Repository layout

```
apply.mjs             the applier: --list --roots --check --apply --revert --show
verify.mjs            offline self-test + personal-information scan
manifest.json         every patch's metadata: hashes, sizes, markers, risk, why, applyWhen
lib/manifest.mjs      manifest loading and schema checks
lib/discover.mjs      finds DSH installations (fully adaptive, platform-aware)
lib/unified.mjs       unified-diff parse / apply / revert engine
lib/backup.mjs        .orig backup and restore
lib/hash.mjs          sha256 helpers
patches/<id>/change.diff   the patch itself

plugins.description: Use your Kimi Code / Grok (X Premium) / Google Antigravity / GLM (BigModel) subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers - OAuth sign-in, per-model visibility, drag-to-reorder Auto fallback, and plan quotas from the Settings page. No API keys.
plugins.readme_text:
[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

# dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth

**Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for as LLM providers in DeepSeek Harness — no API key.**

Sign in once per provider from **Settings → Subscriptions** and that provider's models join the session model picker, with its plan quota shown live next to the connection. Tokens stay on your machine; every request streams through the provider's own API.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth)
[![Licence: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

## Supported providers

| Provider | What you get | Sign-in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Kimi Code** | `kimi-for-coding`, `k3` (1M), `k3-256k` — read from the endpoint's own model list | OAuth device flow (show code, confirm in browser) |
| **Grok (X Premium)** | whatever the account's own model list reports (e.g. `grok-4.7`), **⚡ lightspeed** fast variant | Browser OAuth (auto-redirect) |
| **Google Antigravity** | Claude Sonnet/Opus, Gemini Flash, GPT-OSS, with reasoning tiers — read from the account's own list | Google account OAuth |
| **GLM (BigModel)** | whatever the coding host lists (e.g. `glm-5.3`, `glm-5.3-flash`) | ZCode browser sign-in (polled) |
| **Volcengine Ark** | the plan's own coding models | Volcengine SSO |
| **Xiaomi MiMo** | MiMo's own model list, with the app's two-model set as the fallback | Xiaomi account (QR / password) |
| **WorkBuddy (国内版)** | Hy, GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiniMax models | Browser OAuth (Tencent) |

Every provider also feeds the **`auto`** route, which spans them all: pick `auto` and the harness walks your enabled models in order until one answers.

## Features

- **One sign-in per provider** — no API keys to find, paste, or rotate. The plugin runs the provider's own OAuth/device flow and keeps the token on disk (`~/.dsh/plugins/kimi-oauth/auth.json`, mode `0600`).
- **Live plan usage** — the Settings card and the composer chip show each account's remaining quota (Kimi's 5-hour / weekly windows + credit, Grok's weekly credit, Antigravity's Gemini + Claude buckets, GLM/Ark/MiMo/WorkBuddy credits), with a meter and reset time.
- **Model picker integration** — each provider's models appear in the session picker with context windows and reasoning tiers; hide or re-order them per provider.
- **Catalogs come from the provider, not from this build** — every route reads its own model list once and caches it as the provider's table, so a model released, renamed or retired server-side shows up (or disappears) without a plugin update. Signing in and the Settings **refresh models** action are what re-read it; browsing the picker never spends a request.
- **⚡ Fast / lightspeed variants** — for models that have one (e.g. Grok 4.7 → `grok-4.7-build-fast`), a bolt button beside the model selector switches to the fast variant; it reads as a reasoning rung so the base model always stays selectable.
- **Cross-account pool** — sign in to several accounts on one provider; the plugin draws on the next account when one's allowance runs out.
- **Auto fallback** — `auto` moves to the next enabled model when a provider refuses the preferred one (renamed, rate-limited, out of quota), and stops falling back once a stream has started.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth
```

Then restart DeepSeek Harness and open **Settings → Subscriptions** (订阅).

To install a specific version, or straight from the repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth@0.10.2
dsh plugin --profile web add github:EricFL1998/dsh-subscription-oauth
```

## How to use

1. **Open Settings → Subscriptions.** You see one card per provider; signed-in providers sort to the front, `auto` leads.
2. **Connect** a provider. A browser window (or a device code) starts the provider's own sign-in. Finish it there — the card updates by itself.
3. **Pick a model.** The provider's models now appear in the composer model picker, and the chip shows live usage.
4. **Expand a card** to manage accounts (set default, sign out, refresh token), toggle which models appear, re-order them, add a model id this build doesn't know yet, and see the credential file / endpoints.

> **Tip:** to use a different account on a provider, sign out first, then connect again — the browser sign-in follows whichever account the provider's page is signed in with.

## What it registers

| Surface | What appears |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.llm` | the `kimi`, `grok`, `antigravity`, `glm`, `ark`, `mimo`, `workbuddy` and `auto` provider routes (models, reasoning, streaming) |
| Settings | a **Subscriptions** section: one card per provider |
| Model picker | each provider's own models, plus **`auto`** spanning them all |
| Composer chip | live plan usage for the provider in force |

## Hiding a provider

To keep a provider's models out of the picker without uninstalling, drop it from the route list in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
plugins:
  dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth:
    providers: [kimi, grok, antigravity, glm, ark, mimo, workbuddy]
```

Omit the ones you don't want. The list defaults to every implemented route.

## Security

- Credentials are stored locally at `~/.dsh/plugins/kimi-oauth/auth.json` (mode `0600`, written atomically), one section per provider.
- The plugin talks only to the providers' own hosts and OAuth endpoints — no telemetry, no third-party relay.
- Your subscriptions only; nothing is shared across machines.

## Develop

See the [developer README](README.dev.md) for the full wire protocol, token lifetimes, troubleshooting, and how to run the test suite.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Give DeepSeek Harness its own persistent computer: a bundled microVM with shell, browser, live view and approval gates
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-computer **English** | [中文](#中文说明) Give [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) its own computer: a persistent Linux microVM with a browser, a live desktop view, and approval gates. No Docker required. ![dsh-computer demo](docs/demo.gif) *The agent runs commands and opens a page inside its own VM; the Computer panel in dsh shows its desktop live. (Recorded with a scripted model.)* - **Every agent command runs in the VM**, never on your machine. The session's workspace folder is shared into the VM at the same path. - **Its own browser** (`mcp__vm__browser_*` tools), with logins that persist across restarts. - **Live view inside dsh**: a monitor button in the session header opens a Computer tab in the right sidebar. Watch, click, type, or take over for a QR login or CAPTCHA. - **Audit log**: every command, VM tool call, approval and folder change is appended to `~/.dsh/dsh-computer-audit.jsonl`. - **Phone-friendly live view**: set `publicUrl` (e.g. via `tailscale serve`) and approval messages — including IM approval cards — link to it. - **Approval gates** for risky actions (`sudo`, `rm -rf`, `curl | sh`, `git push`, payment/login/delete clicks), with a link to the live view. - **Always there**: the VM keeps running after dsh quits and dsh reconnects to the same machine on next start. - **Lightweight**: a bundled [microsandbox](https://github.com/microsandbox/microsandbox) microVM (Hypervisor.framework on Apple silicon, WHP on Windows, KVM on Linux); Intel Macs fall back to Docker. ### Install (dsh desktop, macOS) ```bash osascript -e 'quit app "DeepSeek Harness"' "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer open -a "DeepSeek Harness" ``` The first start pulls the VM image (a few GB); agent commands queue until it is ready. Choose the **Computer** permission preset under the input box. Status: v0.5.0, verified on dsh desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 (macOS, Apple silicon). Want a Dots-style always-on agent on top of this (IM, schedules, budget caps)? See **[dsh-dot](https://github.com/Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot)**. Design notes and roadmap: [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md) (Chinese). MIT licensed. --- ## 中文说明 给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）一台自己的电脑：一台常驻的 Linux 微型虚拟机，带浏览器、实时桌面画面和审批闸门。不需要装 Docker。 - agent 的 bash 命令在虚拟机里执行，不碰你的系统。 - agent 的浏览器（`mcp__vm__browser_*` 工具）在虚拟机里，登录态长期保留。 - 你随时可以打开实时画面观看或接手操作（扫码、验证码）。 - 危险操作（`sudo`、`rm -rf`、`curl | sh`、`git push`，以及涉及支付、登录、删除的浏览器动作）先弹审批，审批信息附实时画面链接。闸门同时覆盖 dsh 的 `bash` 和虚拟机自带的 `sandbox_execute_bash` / `sandbox_execute_code`。 - 会话所在的工作区文件夹自动共享进虚拟机，路径不变。 - dsh 退出后虚拟机继续运行；下次启动自动连回同一台。 当前版本 0.5.0，在 dsh 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2（macOS，Apple 芯片）上验证通过。 ## 一、要求 | 项目 | 要求 | |---|---| | 系统 | macOS（Apple 芯片）、Linux（有 `/dev/kvm`）、Windows（开启 Hypervisor Platform）。Intel Mac 自动改用 Docker | | 内存 | 虚拟机默认 4GB 上限，空闲约 0.5GB | | 磁盘 | 约 10GB 空闲（虚拟机镜像） | | 网络 | 首次启动要从 `ghcr.io` 下载镜像；插件会自动使用系统代理 | 虚拟机由 [microsandbox](https://github.com/microsandbox/microsandbox) 运行（libkrun 微型虚拟机，macOS 用 Hypervisor.framework）。它随插件的 npm 依赖一起安装，不需要单独安装。 ## 二、安装 ### dsh 桌面版（macOS） 桌面版使用名为 `desktop` 的配置，要用 App 自带的 dsh 命令安装： ```bash osascript -e 'quit app "DeepSeek Harness"' # 先退出桌面版 "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer open -a "DeepSeek Harness" ``` 重新打开后，在输入框下方的权限选择里会出现 **Computer** 预设。 ### 命令行版 ```bash npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile web add github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer cd ~/某个项目 && dsh web ``` ### 第一次启动 插件会自动下载镜像（几 GB）并创建虚拟机，这期间 agent 的命令排队等待，不会报错。完成后日志出现： ``` computer ready — live view: http://127.0.0.1:18080/vnc/index.html?autoconnect=true&resize=scale ``` ## 三、共享文件夹 - 在某个工作区新建会话并执行命令时，插件自动把这个工作区共享进虚拟机，路径和本机一致。比如 `/Users/你/Documents/项目` 在虚拟机里也是这个路径。 - 共享新文件夹需要重建虚拟机：停机 → 磁盘快照 → 带新文件夹恢复，大约 20 秒。期间的命令自动排队，虚拟机里的文件、安装的软件和浏览器登录态都保留。 - **不会自动共享**：家目录本身、隐藏目录（如 `~/.dsh`、`~/.ssh`）、`~/Library`、`~/Applications`，以及家目录以外的位置。在这些位置启动时，命令在虚拟机的 `/home/gem` 里执行，并共享 `~/dsh-computer/workspace`。 - 想固定共享某些文件夹，在设置里写 `mounts`（见第五节）。显式写出的文件夹不受上面的限制。 ## 四、观看与接管 **在 dsh 界面里**：会话顶部右侧有一个显示器按钮，点一下就在右侧栏打开"虚拟机"标签页，可以直接点击和输入；再点一下收起。也可以在右侧栏的"+"引导页里选"虚拟机"。虚拟机还没就绪时，标签页会显示等待状态并自动重试。 **在浏览器里**： ``` http://127.0.0.1:18080/vnc/index.html?autoconnect=true&resize=scale ``` 看到的就是 agent 的电脑桌面，可以直接点击、输入。 **在手机上（不在电脑旁时）**：端口只监听本机，不要直接暴露到公网。推荐用 [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) 把它安全地转发到你自己的设备： ```bash tailscale serve --bg --https=443 http://127.0.0.1:18080 # 只在你的 tailnet 内可见 ``` 然后把得到的地址（如 `https://my-mac.tailnet-xxxx.ts.net`）写进设置文件的 `publicUrl`。之后审批消息（包括转发到 IM 的审批卡片）里的实时画面链接会用这个地址，在手机上点开就能看和接管。 > 风险：虚拟机的 web 服务本身没有鉴权。`tailscale serve` 只对你 tailnet 里的设备开放；不要用 `tailscale funnel`、端口转发或任何公网隧道直接暴露 18080。 ## 五、配置 桌面版拿不到终端环境变量（只能用 `launchctl setenv` 设置），推荐写设置文件 `~/.dsh/dsh-computer.json`，改完重启 dsh： ```json { "mounts": ["/Users/你/Projects/a", "/Users/你/Projects/b"], "memory": "6G", "cpus": 4 } ``` | 设置项 / 环境变量 | 默认值 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | `mounts` / `DSH_COMPUTER_MOUNTS` | 自动（见第三节） | 固定共享的文件夹；环境变量用 `:` 分隔（Windows 用 `;`） | | `memory` / `cpus` | `4G` / `2` | 虚拟机资源上限 | | `publicUrl` / `DSH_COMPUTER_PUBLIC_URL` | 空 | 从别的设备访问虚拟机 web 服务的地址（见第四节），用于审批消息和状态接口 | | `DSH_COMPUTER_PORT` | `18080` | 虚拟机服务在本机的端口（仅监听 127.0.0.1）；只能用环境变量设置 | | `image` / `DSH_COMPUTER_IMAGE` | `ghcr.io/agent-infra/sandbox:latest` | 虚拟机镜像 | | `backend` / `DSH_COMPUTER_BACKEND` | `auto` | `microsandbox` 或 `docker` | | `DSH_COMPUTER_GATE` | `risky` | `off` 不拦截；`risky` 拦危险命令和敏感浏览器动作；`browser` 每个浏览器动作都审批 | | `DSH_COMPUTER_PRESET` | `computer` | `computer-auto` 关闭审批，只建议在虚拟机里没有重要登录态时用 | ## 六、维护 插件自带的 msb 命令在 dsh 配置目录里（桌面版如下）： ```bash MSB=~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/@superradcompany/microsandbox-darwin-arm64/bin/msb $MSB list # 虚拟机状态 $MSB exec -u gem dsh-computer -- bash # 进入虚拟机 $MSB stop dsh-computer # 停机（下次 dsh 启动自动唤醒） $MSB rm -f dsh-computer # 删除虚拟机；若有快照，下次启动从最近的快照恢复 $MSB snapshot list --group dsh-computer ``` 每次共享新文件夹都会留下一个磁盘快照（`~/.microsandbox/snapshots/dsh-computer/`）。快照是链式的，后一个依赖前一个，不能单独删除；每次增加约 15–20MB。虚拟机被误删时，插件下次启动会从最新快照恢复。要回收空间只能整体重置：`$MSB rm -f dsh-computer` 后删除整个快照目录，虚拟机里的状态会一起清空。 ## 七、出问题时 插件把每次虚拟机操作写进 `~/.dsh/dsh-computer.log`。把最后 50 行发出来即可： ```bash tail -n 50 ~/.dsh/dsh-computer.log ``` | 现象 | 处理 | |---|---| | 日志里有“本机虚拟化不可用” | Windows：管理员执行 `Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName HypervisorPlatform -All` 和 `bcdedit /set "{current}" hypervisorlaunchtype auto`，然后重启 | | 镜像下载很慢或失败 | 确认系统代理可用，或用 `image` 换成能访问的镜像源 | | 浏览器工具报错，bash 正常 | 等一分钟；插件会自动清理浏览器锁文件并重启浏览器 | | agent 命令长时间无输出 | 看日志是否停在 `restore` 或 `pull` | ## 八、已知限制 - Mac 休眠时虚拟机暂停；真正 7×24 常驻需要一直开着的机器。 - 本机端口没有鉴权：`127.0.0.1:18080` 只对本机开放，但本机其他程序都能访问。不要在虚拟机里登录高价值账号。 - 浏览器登录后约 30–45 秒才把 cookie 写盘，立刻共享新文件夹或重启可能丢失刚完成的登录。 - 共享文件夹以外的虚拟机文件（如 `/home/gem`），dsh 的文件读写工具看不到，只能通过命令访问。 - 一个 dsh 配一台虚拟机，还没有“每个会话一台”。 - Docker 后端（Intel Mac）不支持自动共享新文件夹，需要在设置里写 `mounts` 后执行 `docker rm -f dsh-computer`。 - Windows 只验证到虚拟化检测，桌面版完整流程未验证。 ## 九、开发：界面部分 界面代码在 `ui/`，必须用 dsh 官方仓库的 tsdown 预设编译。把 `ui/` 放进官方仓库的 `packages/client/dsh-computer-ui/`，执行 `pnpm install --filter "dsh-computer..."`，然后在该目录运行 `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noCheck && npx tsdown`，把生成的 `lib/client.js` 复制到本插件的 `lib/`。虚拟机端口固定读 18080；改了 `DSH_COMPUTER_PORT` 时，标签页暂时仍连 18080。 ## 十、审计日志与状态接口 **审计日志** `~/.dsh/dsh-computer-audit.jsonl`，每行一条 JSON，超过 10MB 轮转为 `.1`： | `kind` | 何时记录 | 主要字段 | |---|---|---| | `exec` / `terminal` | 每个在虚拟机里启动的进程 | `argv`、`cwd` | | `tool` | 每次 bash 或虚拟机工具调用结束（被拒绝的审批也在这里，`ok: false`） | `tool`、`session`、`args`、`ok`、`error` | | `approval-asked` | 审批闸门要求审批 | `tool`、`session`、`args`、`reason` | | `mount` | 共享 / 取消共享文件夹 | `action`、`dir`、`mounts` | | `status` | 虚拟机状态变化 | `state`、`error` | **状态接口**（给同一 dsh 里的其他插件用，例如 [dsh-dot](https://github.com/Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot)）：注入 `dshComputer` 服务后， ```js ctx.dshComputer.status() // { state: 'starting' | 'shell-only' | 'ready' | 'remounting' | 'error', // backend, liveViewUrl, publicLiveViewUrl, mounts, error } const stop = ctx.dshComputer.onStatus((snapshot) => { /* 状态变化时调用 */ }) ``` `dshComputer.audit

plugins.description: Keeps the DeepSeek Harness context-usage ring honest: an empty usage sample during a retry no longer collapses it to 0%, and its percentage matches the figures beside it.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-usage-guard

Keeps the DeepSeek Harness composer's context-usage ring honest: an empty usage
sample during a retry no longer collapses it to `0%`, and its percentage is
typeset at the size of the figures beside it.
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/releases/tag/v0.2.0)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin that repairs two defects in the composer's **context-usage ring** — one in
the value it shows, one in how large that value is drawn:

1. the ring stops dropping to `0%` while a model request is being retried — the
   host half; and
2. the ring's percentage renders at the size of every other figure on its own
   line — the browser half, one stylesheet rule.

## The two bugs it repairs

```
One line, in the composer footer:

  182 steps · 238 tok/s      33.4M tok · Cache hit 94%      ◯ 30%
                                                             ↑
              the ring's 30% was one pixel larger than every other figure

Mid-retry, the same ring read 0% instead of holding the last real reading:

  ◯ 0%   →   ◯ 6%
```

### The ring collapses to `0%` while a request is being retried

The ring renders the session projection `contextPressure`. That projection takes
the **newest usage sample** as the current prompt size and publishes:

```text
pressureTokens  = usage.inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens
projectedTokens = max(0, pressureTokens + surfaceTokens - sampledSurfaceTokens)
```

A model call that fails before the provider reports anything — a `429`, a rate
limit, a timeout, a transport error, or a user cancellation — still ends its
stream with a `usage` chunk:

```jsonc
[ { "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "usage",  "usage": { "inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 0, "totalTokens": 0 } } },
  { "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "finish", "reason": { "kind": "error",
      "failure": { "code": "RATE_LIMIT", "message": "429: token_capacity_exceeded" } } } } ]
```

The adapter's accumulator starts at zero and nothing ever overwrote it, so this
sample is *empty*, not a measurement. But it is the newest sample, so
`pressureTokens` becomes `0`, and because the sample is stamped at the current
surface total the projection publishes `projectedTokens: 0`. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`
then retries the same step — six times in the session this plugin was written
from — and the ring reads `0%` for the whole storm, misreporting a context that
never changed.

Measured against the shipped `contextPressure` fold, replaying that session's
real events (`test/fold.spec.ts`):

| Replay | `pressureTokens` | `projectedTokens` | Ring |
|---|---|---|---|
| after the last successful call, before the retry | 64 389 | 64 389 | `6%` |
| the failed attempt, **unguarded** | 0 | 0 | `0%` ← the symptom |
| the failed attempt, **guarded** | 64 389 | 64 389 | `6%` |
| the retried step finally succeeds | 64 575 | 64 575 | `6%` |

### The percentage is one pixel larger than the figures beside it

The same footer band holds the session statistics and the ring, and the two
shipped stylesheets disagree by one pixel about how big a figure is:

```css
/* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat — StatsPills.module.css, the pills */
.bOPqQW_root    { font-size: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) - 1px) }

/* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation — ContextMeter.module.css, the ring */
.JObwrW_trigger { font-size: var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) }
```

Both prefixes are content-hashed per build — the pair above is what the
`0.2.0-rc.2` packages installed here carry; the *declarations* are what matters,
and `test/meter-typography.spec.ts` re-reads them from the installed packages
rather than trusting this block.

So `30%` renders about 8% larger than the `182 steps`, `238 tok/s`, `33.4M tok`
and `Cache hit 94%` beside it, which reads as a different typeface. Measured on a
screenshot of that line: every other figure has a 12 px cap height, the ring's
has 13–14 px — a ratio of 1.08, exactly `13 ÷ 12`. The meter's own breakdown
panel is already `12px`, so the trigger is the outlier.

## What the plugin does

| Half | Surface | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `llm/stream` waterfall | one listener that withholds an empty usage sample belonging to a failed attempt, so the projection keeps its last real reading |
| Browser | the document `head` | one self-tagged stylesheet rule that puts the meter's percentage at the statistics pills' figure size |

Neither half adds a page, a route, a settings section or a stored file. The host
half declares `inject: ['llm']`, so the LLM service must exist first, and it
registers inside `ctx.effect`: cordis runs the disposer on unload, when the
profile patch disables the row, or at shutdown — a bare `ctx.on` would leak the
listener past unload.

One rule, applied to the chunk stream of every model call:

> A usage sample whose **every reported count is zero** measures nothing. When it
> belongs to an attempt that ended in `error` or `aborted`, it is dropped, so the
> previous real reading stands.

Everything else passes through untouched:

- **a successful completion**, whatever it reports — `stop`, `tool-calls` and
  `max-tokens` are authoritative provider answers, so a zero there is left for
  the consumer to judge;
- **a failed attempt that did report something** — a partial call can carry real
  input counts, so no billed counter is ever discarded;
- **stream shape, order and timing** — the withheld sample is the only chunk that
  moves; visible deltas keep their order and the terminal `finish` the retry
  executor reads is preserved.

## How the fix works

### Host half: the sample that decides the reading never lands

The wrapper holds **at most one** `usage` chunk and releases it immediately
before the next chunk, so the only chunk whose position can change is the sample
that decides the outcome. A stream that ends without its terminal `finish` still
releases a held sample — the guard never swallows information it did not
positively decide to drop. Withholding the chunk is legal in the stream protocol:
`usage` may appear at most once and is never required, `BlockAssembler.usage`
stays `undefined` without it, and the agent loop already omits the durable
event's `usage` field rather than failing. Token accounting is unaffected — the
projection's usage fold adds an empty sample's buckets as zero anyway, which
`test/fold.spec.ts` pins directly.

### Browser half: one stylesheet rule

The browser half adds one stylesheet rule that repeats the statistics
declaration verbatim:

```css
button[aria-haspopup="dialog"]:has(> svg > circle) {
  font-size: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) - 1px);
}
```

- **Structural selector, not a class name.** The meter's button is the only
  dialog-opening control whose icon *is* the ring — an inline `<svg>` with
  `<circle>` children — while the statistics pills draw `<path>` icons. A build
  that re-hashes every class

plugins.description: Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as image/png so local OpenAI-compatible vision servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp) accept them.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-webp-relabel

Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as PNG, so local OpenAI-compatible
vision servers accept them.

English | [简体中文](#简体中文)

## The problem

You paste a screenshot into DeepSeek Harness, pick a local vision model, and the
request dies with:

```
'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.
```

The image is fine. The **label** is not.

## Why it happens

DSH normalizes attachments before storing them, and `dsh-attachment-local` picks
the container from the alpha channel:

```js
const mediaType = hasAlpha ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
```

Screenshots have an alpha channel, so they are stored as WebP. The request-image
ladder only ever emits `alpha:webp` or `opaque:jpeg` — there is no PNG rung and no
configuration option for this.

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` then builds the OpenAI `image_url` payload straight from the
prepared request image:

```js
mimeType: version.mediaType,               // "image/webp"
data: Buffer.from(version.data).toString("base64"),
```

so the wire payload becomes `data:image/webp;base64,...`. LM Studio / llama.cpp
validate that label against a PNG/JPEG allowlist and reject the whole call —
even though the bytes decode perfectly well.

## How it works

Wrap `attachments.readImageRequest()` and return **the same bytes** under a
compatible label:

```js
return { ...version, mediaType: 'image/png' };
```

Measured against LM Studio with `test/diagnostics/relabel-vs-transcode.py`:

| Payload | Result |
|---------|--------|
| webp bytes + `image/webp` | **HTTP 400** `'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.` |
| webp bytes + `image/png`  | **HTTP 200**, image correctly understood |
| png bytes + `image/png`   | HTTP 200 |
| png bytes + `image/webp`  | **HTTP 400** |

Only the label is validated, so no image transcoding is needed.
`test/diagnostics/vision-read.py` confirms the model really sees the image:
it reads a word drawn into a WebP image sent as `image/png`.

Three implementation details matter, and each was verified rather than assumed:

- **Why not rewrite the request messages?** The adapter takes the label from
  `readImageRequest(...).mediaType`, not from the message's
  `ImageBlock.attachment.mediaType`. Rewriting messages changes nothing.
- **Why is a service patch picked up immediately?** The adapter resolves the
  service per call (`resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get("attachments")`), so
  wrapping the method affects the very next request — no restart, no new session.
- **Why the prototype instead of the instance?** `ctx.get()` returns a Cordis
  "traceable" `Proxy` whose `set` trap routes through an extra shadow receiver, so
  an instance-level write is not reliably observable. A property on the prototype
  is always found by the proxy's own descriptor walk.

The model-visible attachment handle text is unaffected: it is built from
`ref.mediaType`, not `version.mediaType`, so it still describes the stored WebP
accurately.

## Install

### From a release tarball (no registry needed)

Download `dsh-webp-relabel-1.0.0.tgz` from the repository's Releases page, then:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /path/to/dsh-webp-relabel-1.0.0.tgz
```

### From npm

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-webp-relabel
```

### From a local checkout (verified)

Point the plugin manager at the directory:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-webp-relabel
```

The package is then registered as a link dependency, and its own
`cordis.patch.yml` supplies the loader row — so installing the bundle is the only
step. (Observed on DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`: `install_bundle` does **not** insert a row
by itself, which is why this bundle ships its own.)

Installing entirely by hand instead? Add the row to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webp-relabel
      name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
```

## Configuration

The bundle already applies these defaults; add this block to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` only to override them:

```yaml
- id: dsh-webp-relabel
  name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
  config:
    from: image/webp     # label to replace (default)
    to: image/png        # replacement label (default)
    debug: true          # log one line per relabeled image (default)
```

## Verify it works

With `debug: true` the DSH console prints one line per relabeled image:

```
[dsh-webp-relabel] relabel #1: image/webp -> image/png (1200x800px, 84521B, ref sha256:...)
```

You can also check the model server's own request log: the payload should contain
`"url": "data:image/png;base64,..."` rather than `image/webp`.

## Disable / uninstall

Disable the plugin in the DSH plugin manager, or set `to: image/webp` in the
config. Either way the original `readImageRequest` is restored from the saved
descriptor — the patch is fully reversible.

## Limitations

- **The label does not match the container.** The bytes stay WebP while the label
  says PNG. This is correct for servers that validate the label (LM Studio,
  llama.cpp). A provider that strictly validates magic bytes would still reject
  it, and the right fix there is real transcoding (`sharp`, `sips`) rather than
  relabeling.
- **It applies to every provider,** because `readImageRequest()` cannot see which
  route the call is going to. Scoping it to local routes would need an extra
  `llm/stream` listener keyed by `options.provider`.
- **It depends on DSH internals:** the `attachments` service, its
  `readImageRequest` method, and that method being a class method on the
  prototype. If a DSH upgrade breaks it, those are the two things to check.

## Development

```sh
npm test
```

Seven cases in `test/plugin-patch.test.mjs`, covering the relabel itself, that the
patch survives a Cordis-style traceable `Proxy`, that non-WebP labels pass
through untouched, that disposing restores the original method (including when it
is inherited from a base class), configurable targets, and idempotent re-apply.

`test/diagnostics/` holds the server-side probes described above.

---

## 简体中文

把 DSH 归一化出来的 WebP 请求图片**重标记为 PNG**，让本地 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型愿意收下它。

### 问题

在聊天窗口粘贴截图、选一个本地视觉模型，请求直接失败：

```
'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.
```

图片本身没问题，**标签**不对。

### 原因

`dsh-attachment-local` 归一化时按 alpha 通道选容器：

```js
const mediaType = hasAlpha ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
```

截图带 alpha，于是被存成 WebP；请求图档（ladder）只有 `alpha:webp` 和
`opaque:jpeg` 两级，没有 PNG，也没有对应配置项。

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 再把 `version.mediaType` 直接写进 OpenAI 的 `image_url`：

```js
mimeType: version.mediaType,               // "image/webp"
data: Buffer.from(version.data).toString("base64"),
```

于是线上载荷变成 `data:image/webp;base64,...`。LM Studio / llama.cpp 只允许
PNG/JPEG 标签，整条请求被拒——而字节本身完全能解码。

### 做法

包装 `attachments.readImageRequest()`，**字节一个不改**，只换标签：

```js
return { ...version, mediaType: 'image/png' };
```

实测（`test/diagnostics/relabel-vs-transcode.py`，LM Studio）：

| 载荷 | 结果 |
|------|------|
| webp 字节 + `image/webp` | **HTTP 400** `'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.` |
| webp 字节 + `image/png`  | **HTTP 200**，图片被正确理解 |
| png 字节 + `image/png`   | HTTP 200 |
| png 字节 + `image/webp`  | **HTTP 400** |

即**只校验标签**，所以不需要真的转码。`test/diagnostics/vision-read.py` 进一步确认模型
是"真看见了"：让它读一张以 `image/png` 名义发出的 WebP 图上的字，能读对。

三个关键点都是核实过的，不是推测：

- **为什么不改请求消息？** 适配器的标签来自 `readImageRequest(...).mediaType`，
  不是消息块的 `ImageBlock.attachment.mediaType`，改消息没有任何作用。
- **为什么打补丁立刻生效？** 适配器每次请求都重新解析服务
  （`resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get("attachments")`），所以下一次请求就走新方法，
  不用重启、不用新会话。
- **为什么打在原型而不是实例上？** `ctx.get()` 返回 Cordis 的 "traceable" `Proxy`，
  实例级写入会被 shadow receiver 吞掉；原型属性一定会被 Proxy 的描述符查找命中。

模型可见的图片句柄文案不受影响：它取自 `ref.mediaType` 而不是 `version.mediaType`，
所以仍然准确描述存储的 WebP。

### 安装

本地目录（已实测）：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = link:/绝对路径/dsh-webp-relabel
```

手工安装则在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webp-relabel
      name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
```

### 配置（可选）

```yaml
- id: dsh-webp-relabel
  name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
  config:
    from: image/webp     # 被替换的标签
    to: image/png        # 替换成的标签
    debug: true          # 每张图打印一行日志
```

### 验证

`debug: true` 时 DSH 控制台会打印：

```
[dsh-webp-relabel] relabel #1: image/webp -> image/png

Get an account and credits at https://www.sonicaurastudio.com ## License MIT

plugins.description: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 插件：浏览器 OAuth 登录、无需 API Key。Tencent WorkBuddy LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin for **Tencent WorkBuddy**.

Sign in through your browser — **no API key required** — and use WorkBuddy's own model list.

## Features

- **Browser OAuth sign-in** — authorize in a normal browser tab; no API key needed, ever. Sign in to either the China or the international site.
- **Full model catalog** — WorkBuddy's own models, with context windows, output caps, and credit multipliers; server-side additions and removals are picked up automatically.
- **Streaming chat** — responses stream in real time.
- **Tool calls** — function calling, with a clear error when a model does not support it.
- **Reasoning effort** — pick a thinking level for models that support one.
- **Image input** — attach images for vision-capable models (models without vision support may be routed to a different model by the server).
- **Usage indicator** — a quota bar in the Web UI sidebar for both personal and enterprise plans, with an optional custom cap and a configurable danger threshold.

## Compatibility

| Requirement | Version |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) | `>= 0.1.7-rc.1` |

Web UI features such as the settings page, model picker, and usage indicator require the `web` profile.

## Install

Add the plugin to a dsh profile — the `web` profile backs the Web UI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wenh56884-wq/dsh-llm-workbuddy
```

The repository ships its compiled `lib/`, so a Git install needs no build step and no
dev dependencies. Installing from a source checkout works too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-llm-workbuddy
```

## Sign in

Open **Settings → WorkBuddy** in the Web UI and pick a site: **Sign in (China)** for [www.workbuddy.cn](https://www.workbuddy.cn) or **Sign in (Intl)** for [www.workbuddy.ai](https://www.workbuddy.ai). The browser login opens in a new tab; the harness writes the credential automatically. No terminal needed.

The two sites are the same service on different hosts but hold **separate accounts** — one site's account does not work on the other — so the site is chosen per sign-in and recorded with the credential. Every later request goes to the host that issued it. To move to the other site, sign out and sign in again.

Alternatively, sign in from the terminal:

```bash
# A CLI fallback; the Web UI sign-in above is recommended.

# Sign in to the China site (the default; equivalent to --site cn)
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login

# Sign in to the international site
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --site intl

# Show the signed-in account, its site, and the model list
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --status

# Remove the stored credential
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --logout
```

Once signed in, WorkBuddy's models appear in the model picker.

## Build

From a source checkout:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

This compiles the host half with `tsc` and bundles the Web client half with `esbuild`, both into `lib/`.

## Provenance and license

MIT. This plugin is a WorkBuddy adaptation of
[`@shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy`](https://github.com/shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy)
(MIT, © 2026 Shatyuka), which is the original work it derives from: the host
architecture, the browser-OAuth handshake, the model-catalog reader, the
settings page, and the usage indicator are all its author's design. This
repository re-points that client at the WorkBuddy deployments — the site list,
the product token every request identifies itself as, and the provider,
settings, and credential identifiers are WorkBuddy's — and renames it
accordingly. The upstream copyright notice is retained in
[`LICENSE`](./LICENSE) as the license requires.

When the upstream project releases fixes, they can be diffed in against this
tree: the changes here are confined to the identifiers, the two service roots
in `src/constants.ts`, and the catalogue User-Agent documented there.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: ask_user_question popup enhancement - selecting an option reveals a per-option note input, sent to the model with the selection
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-question-note

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-question-note.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-question-note)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-question-note.svg)](LICENSE)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）「交互式问答」弹窗增强插件：**用户点选某个选项后，在该选项正下方出现一个可选的补充说明输入框；填写的内容与选中的选项一并传给模型。**

## 效果

- 原版弹窗的样式、功能、交互全部保留（组件是官方 `QuestionComposer` 的忠实移植，同一套 CSS 令牌与几何）。
- **补充说明按选项独立存储**：每个被选中的选项下方各有一个自己的补充输入框，互不共享、不随勾选变化移动；取消勾选时输入框隐藏，文字保留（重新勾选会恢复）。单选题换选选项时同理，各选项各记各的。
- 提交时答案格式不变：`{ "answers": [ { "id": "...", "selected": ["选项文字"], "custom": "…" } ] }`。`custom` 的组装规则：单选 = 补充文本原文；多选 = 每个有补充的选项一行、格式「选项文字: 补充」（模型可分清哪句对应哪个选项）；底部自由回答行若有内容追加在最后。不填补充说明时行为与原版完全一致。
- 底部「其他（自定义输入）」行保留，是独立的自由回答入口（单选打字清空已选 = 原版语义；多选与勾选并存 = 原版语义）。
- 计划审查（plan-review）类卡片、审批卡片、超时后续答、已结算回答回看等全部由官方组件处理，本插件不接管。

## 与原版的唯一行为差异

启用后，**单选点选项不再自动跳到下一题**（原版会跳，但那会让用户没机会填写补充说明），而是停留在当前题并展开输入框；在输入框里回车或点「下一题」按钮进入下一题，最后一题回车即提交。

## 实现原理（面向二次开发者）

- 纯客户端 Cordis 插件：浏览器半往 `conversation.composer` 链式槽以 `priority: -10`（官方在默认 0）注册增强版组件，链选举「数值小者先跑、第一个 select 非 null 者胜出」，因此增强版先被询问并接管通用问题卡的渲染；官方插件的卡片注册、倒计时、投影、续答机制原样复用（`src/client/carrier.ts` 以结构化方式消费官方载体对象）。
- 鸭子类型失配时 `select` 返回 null → 安全降级为官方弹窗（功能缺失但弹窗可用）。
- 合并方案零协议改动：宿主端 `userQuestions.answer()` 只校验「每题恰好回答一次」，不禁止 `selected` 与 `custom` 并存；工具结果与超时续答消息都是原样 JSON 透传。

## 开发与安装

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # 产出 lib/index.js（宿主半）与 lib/client.js（浏览器半）
pnpm run check     # 产物语法检查

# 安装到 desktop 配置（会写入 dsh.profile.bundles，需重启 DSH 生效）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本目录路径或 npm 包名>
```

## 版本兼容

针对 DSH 0.2.0-rc 族（`@deepseek-ai/*` peer `^0.2.0-rc.1`）。官方弹窗组件内部结构若在后续版本变化，需同步调整 `src/client/carrier.ts` 的结构匹配与 `src/client/composer.tsx` 的移植。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把多台 SSH 服务器存成主机清单，agent 在会话里按主机名引用（命令执行 + 远端文件读写）；设置界面管理，支持密钥/密码登录，会话窗口「+」菜单可选主机。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ssh-hosts

[![test](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）加一组 SSH 工具：**把若干台服务器存成一份主机清单，agent 在会话里用主机名引用它们** —— 执行命令、读文件、写文件、改文件、列目录。

- 凭据只存**怎么连**（host / user / identityFile / 跳板），不存密码、不存密钥内容；
- 认证、known_hosts、ssh-agent 全部交给系统 OpenSSH，插件不重新实现加密；
- 多机：同时配置 N 台，一次调用指定一台；会话里可以 `ssh_use` 设默认机；
- **图形界面管理**：在 `设置 → 插件 → dsh-ssh-hosts`（或设置侧栏「SSH 主机」）里新增/编辑/删除主机、测连通性、设默认机；界面写的就是那份 YAML，改完立即生效，不用重启；
- 与本地同名工具语义一致（`read` 的 offset/limit 是行号，`edit` 要求 oldString 唯一）。

## 装

### 方式零：直接从 GitHub

```bash
git clone https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-ssh-hosts      # 桌面版则在「设置 → 插件」里选这个目录
```

[Releases](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/releases) 里也有打包好的 `dsh-ssh-hosts-x.y.z.tgz`，适合离线安装或内网分发。

### 方式一：桌面 App / CLI 的插件安装（推荐）

```bash
# CLI：把本目录（或 npm pack 出的 tgz）装进某个 profile
dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/plugin-dev/ssh-hosts
```

装完 `dsh web --dump-config | grep -A2 ssh-hosts` 应该能看到：

```
# == dsh-ssh-hosts
- id: ssh-hosts
  name: dsh-ssh-hosts
```

桌面版也可以在 **设置 → 插件** 里安装同一个 tgz / 目录；本插件声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，安装后会自动作为一层 bundle 参与 profile 组装（`insert` 一行 `id: ssh-hosts`）。

> 桌面 App 自己的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 独占：`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 会被拒绝（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。要装进桌面 App，请从 App 内的插件界面装，或者按 App 写 package.json 的方式加 `link:`/依赖后由 App 重启加载 —— 别去手改它的 profile 状态。

### 方式二：手写 patch 行

不想用它自带的 bundle patch、或想在别人的 profile 里手动挂，就在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`（或 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`）里加：

```yaml
- insert:
  - id: 'ssh-hosts'
    name: 'dsh-ssh-hosts'      # 也可以写 file:///绝对路径/plugin-dev/ssh-hosts/lib/index.js
    config:
      defaultHost: web-01
```

`config` 全部字段都有默认值，只写需要覆盖的即可。

## 配置

主机清单有两条路，用的是**同一份数据**（`ssh-hosts.yaml`）：

- **图形界面（推荐）**：装好后打开 `设置 → 插件 → dsh-ssh-hosts`（或设置侧栏的「SSH 主机」），在那里新增/编辑/删除主机、测试连通性、设默认机。界面写的就是下面这个 YAML，写完立即重载，**不用重启**。
- **手工编辑**：直接改 YAML；改完在界面上点「重新读取」，或重启。

![设置里的 SSH 主机卡片（窄列 ~340px）](docs/settings-card.png)

*窄列下的样子：一台主机一个块，事实在上、操作在下，长路径自己断行。*

界面能做的事：

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 新增 / 编辑 / 删除 / 设默认 | 字段校验与服务端同一套规则：错了当场红框标出**并说明怎么改**，不用等一次 400 |
| 测试连接 | 结果就地显示在那台主机下面（成功给耗时与远端首行，失败给 exit code 与原因），不用去翻底部日志 |
| 删除二次确认 | 在块内确认，并说清会连带清掉什么（例如「已存密码也一并清除」），不可撤销 |
| 过滤 | 主机多了按名称 / 地址 / 标签 / 备注 / 认证方式过滤，并显示匹配台数 |
| 键盘 | `Enter` 保存、`Esc` 取消；错误是 `role="alert"`、日志是 `aria-live`，读屏能听到 |
| 密码 | 只写不读：显示「已保存（来自哪一层）」或「未设置」，输入可显示/隐藏，清除要再确认一次 |
| 空状态 | 没有主机时直接给「新增主机」按钮 + 手工编辑提示，不用猜下一步做什么 |

### 1. 主机清单（界面与手工共用的那份文件）

```bash
cp ssh-hosts.example.yaml ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml
chmod 600 ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml     # 权限不是 0600 会被拒绝加载
$EDITOR ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml
```

文件**不存在**时插件照常启动、界面照常打开，只是清单为空：在界面上新增第一台主机就会把文件建出来（0600）。文件存在但坏掉（YAML 语法错、`hosts` 不是数组、权限过宽）仍然是**装载期硬失败** —— 那是真配置错误，越早炸越好。

```yaml
version: 1

hosts:
  - name: web-01                    # ← agent 在会话里引用的名字
    host: 10.0.0.11
    user: deploy
    identityFile: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 # 密钥登录；必须 0600。省略 = 交给 ssh-agent/默认密钥
    defaultWorkdir: /srv/app
    description: 生产 Web（Nginx）
    tags: [prod, web]
    port: 22
    proxyJump: bastion              # 本清单里的 name，或 user@host:port
    connectTimeoutSec: 15
    keepAliveSec: 30
    readOnly: true                  # 拒绝 ssh_write / ssh_edit

  - name: db-01
    host: 10.0.0.12
    user: root
    passwordRef: DSH_SSH_HOSTS_PASSWORD_DB_01   # 密码登录：只写「凭据名」，不写密码
    tags: [prod, db]
```

字段全部可选（`name` / `host` 必填），**未知字段会直接报错**，拼错不会被静默忽略。清单里写 `password:` / `passphrase:` 会被专门拒绝，并告诉你该怎么放密码。

### 1.1 登录方式：密钥 / 密码 / ssh-agent

| 方式 | 清单里怎么写 | 怎么设置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **密钥**（推荐） | `identityFile: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` | 界面「登录方式 → 密钥文件」，填路径即可（文件必须存在且 0600） |
| **密码** | `passwordRef: DSH_SSH_HOSTS_PASSWORD_XXX` | 界面「登录方式 → 密码」，在密码框里填一次；插件把值交给 DSH 凭据库，清单里只留引用名 |
| **密钥优先、密码兜底** | 两个字段都给 | 界面选「密钥优先，密码兜底」 |
| **ssh-agent / 默认密钥** | 两个字段都不给 | 界面选「ssh-agent / 默认密钥」，交给 OpenSSH 自己挑 |

密码**不进清单文件**：`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（0600，DSH 自己的凭据库）存值，`ssh-hosts.yaml` 只存名字。所以清单可以安全地备份/分享；界面、HTTP 响应、模型可见的工具输出里都**只回报「有没有、来自哪一层」**，永远不回显密码。删主机或点「清除已存密码」会顺手把凭据库里的那条删掉，不留孤儿。

密码登录的实现是 OpenSSH 官方路子（`SSH_ASKPASS` + 一次性 0600 文件）：密码不进命令行参数、不进环境变量、不进日志，`ps` 里看不到；每次调用前现解析、用完即删，所以改完密码**下一次调用就生效**，不用重启。没有凭据服务的 profile（极少见）插件照常工作，只是密码主机连不上，界面会说明原因。

### 2. 图形界面背后的 HTTP 路由

界面（浏览器半边）通过同源路由读写清单，也**可以只用 curl**（同一个 web server，CSRF/Host 校验与其它 GUI 接口一致）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/ssh-hosts/hosts` | 清单 + 文件信息 + 是否可写 + 默认机 |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/hosts` | 新增/修改一台（`{ host: {...}, previousName?, password?, clearPassword? }`，改名靠 `previousName`；`password` 只进不出，`clearPassword: true` 清除） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/hosts/delete` | 删除（`{ name }`） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/default` | 设/清默认机（`{ name }`，空串清除） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/reload` | 重新读盘（手工改完文件点这个） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/test` | 真实 SSH 连上去跑一条只读命令 |

返回统一是 `{ ok: true, value }` 或 `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`；`400` 参数/文件内容有误、`409` 清单来自 config 不可写、`404` 主机不存在、`501` 当前 profile 没有凭据服务（存不了密码）、`403/401` 未过 Host/来源/登录校验。写入顺序是**先校验、再原子写、再重载**，重载失败会把文件回滚成写之前的字节 —— 界面上一次误操作不会让正在跑的会话失去目标机。

### 3. 插件 config

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hostsFile` | `$DSH_HOME/ssh-hosts.yaml` | 清单路径；相对路径按 `$DSH_HOME` 解析 |
| `defaultHost` | 空 | 没指定 host、本会话也没 `ssh_use` 过时用的默认机 |
| `knownHostsFile` | 空（OpenSSH 默认） | 自定义 known_hosts 路径 |
| `strictHostKeyChecking` | `accept-new` | `accept-new` / `yes` / `no` |
| `connectTimeoutSec` | 10 | 建连超时 |
| `timeoutMs` | 60000 | 单条命令默认超时 |
| `maxOutputBytes` | 262144 | stdout/stderr 各自保留上限（超出保尾并标记截断） |
| `maxReadBytes` | 8388608 | 单文件读取上限 |
| `controlPersistSec` | 300 | 连接复用时长；0 = 每次重建连 |
| `allow` / `deny` | `[]` | `ssh_run` 命令正则白/黑名单（deny 优先） |
| `hosts` | `[]` | 就地声明主机（非空时忽略 `hostsFile`） |

这些标量字段都是 DSH 的 **volatile** 字段：在设置页改完**不用重启插件**，下一次工具调用就用新值（插件每次读配置都解包 volatile 引用）。`hosts` 例外 —— 它是部署方声明，改了要重启；而且它非空时界面变成只读，避免「设置页改一半、YAML 改一半」。

## 用：添加完主机，怎么引用

**在会话窗口里直接选**（新增，最快）：点输入框左边的 **「+」**，在命令菜单里选 **`ssh`** → 弹出主机列表（带 `user@host`、标签、认证方式，并标出本会话当前在用哪台）→ 点一台即可。它设的是**本会话**默认主机（和 `ssh_use` 同一条路径、同一份状态），之后你在这个会话里说「执行 uname -a」就直接落到那台机器。也可以手打 `/ssh <主机名>`，`/ssh clear` 清除。

> 一个平台规则：输入框里**已经有内容**时，「+」菜单只列不带参数的命令（`ssh` 带参数提示，所以那时不显示）—— 这是 DSH 对斜杠菜单的统一约定，`/permission` 等命令同样如此。想在已有草稿上换机器，先选中草稿前的空白再点「+」，或直接手打 `/ssh <主机名>`。

**在会话里直接说人话也行**（最常用）：

```
在 web-01 上执行 systemctl status nginx
看一下 db-01 的 /etc/mysql/my.cnf
把 web-01 的 /srv/app/.env 里 PORT=8080 改成 PORT=9090
```

agent 会先 `ssh_hosts()` 看清单，再带上 `host: "web-01"` 调用对应工具。主机名就是你在界面里填的「名称」。

**显式调用**（想知道底层发生了什么时）：

```
ssh_hosts()                                        → 列主机（含 auth 方式、tags、默认目录）
ssh_use({ host: "web-01" })                        → 设为本会话默认机，之后可以省略 host
ssh_run({ command: "uname -a" })                   → 在默认机上跑
ssh_run({ host: "db-01", command: "df -h" })       → 指定机器跑（不依赖默认机）
ssh_read({ host: "web-01", path: "/etc/nginx/nginx.conf", offset: 1, limit: 40 })
ssh_write({ host: "web-01", path: "/tmp/hello.txt", content: "hi\n" })
ssh_edit({ host: "web-01", path: "/srv/app/.env", oldString: "PORT=8080", newString: "PORT=9090" })
ssh_ls({ host: "web-01", path: "/srv/app" })
```

主机解析优先级：**显式 `host` 参数 → 本会话 `ssh_use` → 界面设的默认机 → `config.defaultHost` → 报错并列出可用主机**（绝不再猜一台）。界面上点「设为默认」写的就是第三档；默认机是**全局**的，`ssh_use` 是**本会话**的。

模型看到的 7 个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `ssh_hosts` | 列出可用主机（含 tags / 说明 / 默认目录 / 认证方式），可按 tag 过滤；`defaultHost` + `defaultSource` 告诉你本次调用实际会用哪台 |
| `ssh_use` | 读/设本会话默认主机，之后其它工具可省略 `host` |
| `ssh_run` | 执行命令，返回 exitCode / stdout / stderr（**非零退出是正常结果**） |
| `ssh_read` | 读文本文件，可给行号区间 |
| `ssh_write` | 整文件写入（远端临时文件 + rename 原子替换，保留原权限） |
| `ssh_edit` | 精确字符串替换（要求唯一匹配，除非 `replaceAll`） |
| `ssh_ls` | 列目录（类型/权限/大小/时间） |

主机解析优先级：**显式 `host` 参数 → 本会话 `ssh_use` → 界面设的默认机 → `config.defaultHost` → 报错并列出可用主机**（绝不再猜一台）。

三种方式的作用域要分清：**会话窗口的「+ → ssh」和 `ssh_use` 是「本会话」**（互不干扰，换会话就没了）；**设置页的「设为默认」是全局**（所有没有会话默认的会话都用它）。`ssh_hosts` 报的 `defaultHost` 是**本次调用实际会用的那台**（会话默认 → 全局默认 → `config.defaultHost`），`defaultSource` 告诉你是哪一档。

plugins.description: Cell-aware Jupyter notebook tools for DSH agents
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-notebook-tools

Cell-aware Jupyter notebook tools for DSH agents. A zero-dependency Node ESM
plugin that ports the OpenClaw `notebook-tools` plugin (9 tools) onto the DSH
host.

The core `read` / `write` / `edit` tools treat `.ipynb` files as opaque JSON,
which is error-prone, token-hungry, and easy to corrupt. This plugin provides a
structured, cell-aware API instead: stable cell ids, output-aware truncation,
stale-edit guards, and format-preserving atomic writes.

## Install

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add --config.minimumReleaseAge=0 F:\path\to\dsh-plugin-notebook-tools
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to the pnpm bundled with DSH, and `--profile` is
required. The `--config.minimumReleaseAge=0` override is needed while the
target profile's *existing* lockfile entries are newer than pnpm's default
`minimumReleaseAge` cutoff (pnpm 11.7.0 enforces that default even when the
profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` lists the same offenders under
`minimumReleaseAgeExclude`). Without it you get
`ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION` naming packages you did not touch.

On success the package is appended to **both** `dependencies` and
`dsh.profile.bundles` in `<DSH_HOME>\profiles\<profile>\package.json` — no
manual edit needed. A failed run can still leave a link in `node_modules`, so
treat the `package.json` entry, not `node_modules`, as proof.

The plugin ships a `cordis.patch.yml` that inserts it under the id
`notebook-tools`. DSH composes that row at boot, so **restart the DSH app** for
the tools to appear in an already-running session.

No dependencies are installed: `pnpm install` is unnecessary, and the package
imports only `node:` builtins.

## Companion skill

`skill/notebook-tools/SKILL.md` is the matching DSH skill: it tells the agent
when to reach for these tools, which of them can mutate a notebook, and how
stable a cell id really is. Copy it into the skills directory:

```powershell
Copy-Item -Recurse skill\notebook-tools "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\notebook-tools" -Force
```

DSH hot-reloads the skills directory, so the skill shows up without a restart —
unlike the plugin itself, which is composed at boot.

## Tools

| Tool | Writes | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notebook_create` | yes | Create a notebook from structured cells |
| `notebook_read` | no | Structured read, optionally with outputs |
| `notebook_list_cells` | no | Cheap index: id, type, preview, counts |
| `notebook_search` | no | Find cells by text or regex |
| `notebook_validate` | no | Validate structure and report facts |
| `notebook_edit_cell` | yes | Replace a cell's source / type |
| `notebook_insert_cell` | yes | Insert a new cell at a position |
| `notebook_delete_cell` | yes | Delete a cell by id or index |
| `notebook_clear_outputs` | yes | Clear outputs (all or one cell) |

## Guarantees

- **Writes preserve the file's own formatting.** The plugin probes the layout a
  notebook already uses — JSON indent (0/1/2/4), CRLF vs LF, trailing newline —
  and writes it back unchanged, so a notebook produced by JupyterLab,
  `nbformat.writes`, or a text editor is not reformatted. A cell whose `source`
  is a plain string stays a string, and keys that were absent (`outputs`,
  `execution_count`, `metadata`) are not invented. Read-then-write with no edit
  is byte-identical. Not preserved: tab indentation, `\uXXXX`-escaped non-ASCII
  (Python's `ensure_ascii=True`), and more than one trailing newline.
- **Atomic saves.** Mutations serialize to a sibling temp file
  (`.‹basename›.tmp-‹pid›-‹counter›-‹random›`) in the same directory, `fsync` it,
  then `rename` over the target. A killed process can never leave a half-written
  notebook, and no temp file ever lands in the system temp directory.
- **Validation before every write.** A notebook that fails the deep audit — cell
  ids outside `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` or duplicated, non-object `metadata`,
  non-array `outputs`, non-string `source` elements — is refused by the writers
  and reported by `notebook_validate`, instead of being silently rewritten.
- **Cell ids over indexes.** `notebook_read`, `notebook_list_cells`, and
  `notebook_search` always return an `id`. A notebook too old to store ids
  (nbformat < 4.5) gets ids derived from `sha256("v1|<ordinal>|<source>")`, so
  the same cell keeps the same id across loads and processes; the derived id is
  persisted only once the file's format supports ids. `nbformat_minor` is never
  bumped. Indexes shift after every insert/delete — prefer ids.
- **Editing a code cell clears `outputs` and `execution_count`,** and the
  response text says so.
- **Three stale-edit guards on every mutating tool.** `expected_file_sha256`
  catches any change to the bytes on disk — including a rewrite inside the same
  millisecond, which `expected_file_mtime_ms` cannot see; `expected_source_sha256`
  catches a change to the one cell an operation depends on (the anchor cell for
  an insert, the target cell for an edit, delete, or clear); the mtime check is
  the cheap one and tolerates sub-millisecond jitter. All of them fail *before*
  any write. `notebook_read` and `notebook_list_cells` return both `mtime_ms`
  and `file_sha256`; only `notebook_read` returns per-cell `source_sha256`.
- **nbformat 4 only.** v3 and earlier are rejected.
- **No kernel execution, ever.**
- **Failures throw** a `NotebookError` subclass carrying a stable `code`
  (`NOTEBOOK_NOT_FOUND`, `STALE_NOTEBOOK`, `CELL_NOT_FOUND`, …). There is no
  `isError` field on the DSH tool result contract.

## Usage

```
notebook_list_cells  { path: "~/analysis.ipynb" }
notebook_read        { path: "~/analysis.ipynb", cell_ids: ["a1b2c3d4"] }
notebook_search      { path: "~/analysis.ipynb", query: "train_test_split" }
notebook_edit_cell   { path: "~/analysis.ipynb", cell_id: "a1b2c3d4",
                       new_source: "model.fit(X, y)\n",
                       expected_source_sha256: "…",
                       expected_file_sha256: "…" }
notebook_validate    { path: "~/analysis.ipynb" }
```

Pass the guards straight back from the read that produced them — `file_sha256`
comes from `notebook_read` or `notebook_list_cells`, `source_sha256` only from
`notebook_read`.

## Development

```powershell
node --test          # from this directory
```

Tests use `node:test` + `node:assert/strict` and require Node >= 22 (verified
on Node 24).

## Releasing

Releases are one command, run from a clean `main` that already contains the
version bump:

```powershell
npm run release -- --title "v0.2.1 - short one-line summary"
```

It refuses to run unless `CHANGELOG.md` carries a non-empty `## [<version>]`
section and a `[<version>]:` link reference for the version in `package.json`,
the working tree is clean, and HEAD is the commit that carries the bump. Then it
runs `node --test`, pushes the release branch, creates the annotated tag
`v<version>`, pushes it, and
creates the GitHub Release: the tag annotation is the release title and the
CHANGELOG section is its body. Credentials come from `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN`,
falling back to the stored `git credential` for `github.com` (nothing is ever
printed); the GitHub CLI is not required.

Other flags: `--dry-run` (print the plan, change nothing), `--skip-tests`,
`--branch <name>` (default `main`), `--remote <name>` (default `origin`).

## Layout

```
lib/index.js              composition only — registers the 9 tools on ctx.tools
lib/nb/*.js               pure domain; node: builtins only, no host SDK imports
lib/tools/*.js            adapters: JSON Schema params, error mapping, response text
scripts/release.mjs       the release command behind "npm run release"
test/*.test.js            node:test suites
cordis.patch.yml          the composition row DSH merges at boot
skill/notebook-tools/     the companion skill (SKILL.md)
```

The domain layer (`lib/nb/`) knows nothing about DSH — it only knows about
notebooks, so it stays unit-testable in isolation.

## Credits and license

MIT. This is a **port**, not a fork: the domain layer and all nine tool
adapters were re-implemented for the DSH plugin host from the original plugin's
documented behavior.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-selection-ask · 划词引用

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

> 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 网页版用的**划词引用**插件。
> 在对话里选中一段文字 → 就地写批注 → 它变成**带编号的引用胶囊**落进输入框，
> 原文上同时留下**高亮**和**编号**。删掉胶囊，高亮和编号一起走。

**版本 V0.1**

<!-- 截图位：一张「选中后浮出就地输入栏」、一张「引用之后原文上的高亮与编号」 -->

---

## 它能做什么

读 AI 的长回答时，你经常想指着其中**某一句话**追问："这里为什么这么写？""展开讲讲第三点。"
没有它，你得手动选中 → `Ctrl+C` → 点输入框 → `Ctrl+V` → 再打字，而且粘进去的是一段
**没有形状**的裸文本 —— 模型分不清哪句是你说的、哪句是你引的。

有了它：

- **划词即引用** —— 选中任意文字（AI 的回答、你自己发过的话、工具输出、代码块都行），
  光标旁浮出一条就地输入栏；写批注，或者什么都不写直接回车。
- **每条引用都有身份** —— 一个编号（`选中文本 1`、`2`、`3`…），原文上有对应的
  **高亮**和**编号牌**，悬停胶囊还能看见这条引用的原文。
- **引用会跟着胶囊走** —— 输入框里的胶囊是唯一事实源：删掉它，原文的高亮和编号
  **同时消失**，不会留下"孤儿标注"。
- **落在输入框光标处** —— 新引用插在你光标所在的位置；连续引用多段会依次排开，
  **绝不覆盖**你已经写好的内容。
- **同一处文字不会有两个号** —— 再次引用同一段文字，复用原来的编号。
- **选得更长时自动并进来** —— 先引了短句、再引**包含它的长句**，不会多出一个胶囊，
  而是把原来那条更新成更长的引用。
- **写完就走** —— `Enter` 只写进输入框（你还能接着改），`Ctrl/Cmd + Enter` 写完**直接发送**。
- **跟着主题走** —— 配色取自宿主的设计变量，浅色深色宿主都自适应。

输入框里是一枚编号胶囊，模型收到的仍然是一段规整的 Markdown 引用：

```markdown
> 一句话对照：上面那串"往下压"是递，撞到出口后"往回收"是归——两个动作合起来才叫递归。

（这里接着写你的问题，光标已经在这了）
```

---

## 用法

1. 在网页里**选中一段文字**；
2. 光标旁浮出一条就地输入栏 —— 就地写批注，或者什么都不写；
3. `Enter` 写进输入框 / `Ctrl`（macOS 上 `Cmd`）`+ Enter` 写进输入框**并直接发送**。

| 动作 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 选中正文 | 浮出就地输入栏；那片文字的底色**不会消失** |
| 输入栏里按 `Enter` | 写进输入框，**不发送** —— 你还能接着改、接着补 |
| 输入栏里按 `Ctrl`/`Cmd + Enter` | 写进输入框**并立刻发出去** |
| 写了批注再提交 | 输入框里是 `[胶囊] 你的批注` |
| 悬停胶囊 | 浮出这条引用的原文 |
| **在输入框里删掉胶囊** | 原文的高亮与编号**同时消失** |
| 点别处 / 按 `Esc` | 收起浮层，不动输入框 |
| 在**输入框里**选中文字 | **不出**浮层 —— 那是在编辑，不是在引用 |
| 连续引用多段 | 依次排在光标处，追加而不是覆盖 |
| 选中的内容超过 8000 字 | 截断，并提示「内容过长，已截断」 |

**编号的粒度**：一个页面生命周期内全局递增（`选中文本 1`、`2`、`3`…）；
同一段文字被再次引用时复用原来的编号 —— 同一处标注不该有两个号。

---

## 安装

⚠️ 先纠一个坑（不少插件文档在这里是错的）：**DSH 的命令行直接拒绝 `--profile desktop`** ——

```
$ dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Eos010/dsh-selection-ask
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

桌面版的 profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理。所以按你实际在用的版本二选一：

### 桌面版（Electron 应用）

在 DSH 应用内安装。也可以手动两步：

```powershell
# 1) 把仓库放进 profile 的 node_modules
git clone https://github.com/Eos010/dsh-selection-ask `
  "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-selection-ask"

# 2) 在 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组里加一行：
#      "dsh-selection-ask"

# 3) 重启 DSH，然后刷新网页（Ctrl+F5）
```

### 命令行版 `dsh web`

```bash
npm i -g pnpm        # dsh plugin 是 pnpm 的转发器，PATH 上得先有 pnpm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Eos010/dsh-selection-ask
```

（从本地工作副本装，就把 `github:…` 换成 `file:<你的工作副本路径>`。）

**两种方式装完都要重启一次 DSH**，然后刷新网页（`Ctrl+F5`）——
包清单只在启动时读一次。

卸载就是反过来：从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 删掉那一行、删掉 `node_modules` 下的目录，重启。

---

## 说明与限制

- 原文高亮需要 Chromium 105+（DSH 桌面版与 `dsh web` 都是 Chromium，实测可用）。
- 转录很长时，**滚出屏幕的那段暂时不亮**，滚回来就恢复。
- **侧边提问面板还在完善中**：按钮已经就位，但暂时还发不出问题，先别指望它。
- 更新插件或改完配置后请**刷新页面**（`Ctrl+F5`）。
- 插件不联网、不读文件、不读凭据。若使用侧边提问，它会调用你**自己配好的**模型 ——
  也就是**花你的额度**。

---

## 开发

只需要 Node ≥ 22，运行时零依赖。

```bash
node build.mjs                # 源码 + 样式 → lib/client.js（产物已提交，安装者不需要构建）
node test/bundle.test.mjs     # 产物接线、插槽注册、样式落点
node test/selection.test.mjs  # 引用块形状、草稿拼接、生命周期、编号
```

---

## 许可

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: 用于dsh上使用的操控Alist的插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-alist

让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）通过对话浏览、检索、上传与管理 [AList](https://github.com/AlistGo/alist) v3 的插件。

一句话：把「AList 上有什么、放到哪、谁能看」这件事变成一句话就能办完的事，写操作一律弹原生审批，密码与 Token 只写不读。

> **当前状态**：代码已完成，自检全绿（`npm run verify` → check + 20/20 单测）；
> 目标实例 `http://172.16.2.186:5244` 连通，版本 **v3.64.0**（与插件端点基线一致，已通过 `/api/public/settings` 核实）；
> 插件已 `link:` 装入本机 `web` profile，等重启 DSH 后做端到端验证。
> 首次使用建议先用只读工具试：`alist_me` → `alist_fs_list` → `alist_fs_search`。

## 为什么用它

- 列目录、取文件信息、只列子目录、关键词搜索、看压缩包内部结构、取直链——都在对话里完成。
- 建目录、重命名（单个/批量/正则）、移动、复制、删除、上传、离线下载、解压——写操作触发强制审批。
- 管理端能力：存储挂载/启停/删除、驱动与配置字段查询、用户、角色、元数据、站点设置、搜索索引、会话、分享、标签。
- 凭据保存在本地 DSH 凭证库，**永不回显**给浏览器和模型；敏感字段在返回前递归脱敏。
- AList 返回的一切都当作**不可信数据**，绝不作为指令执行。

## 环境基线

| 组件 | 基线 |
| --- | --- |
| AList | **v3.64.0**（端点以 `server/router.go` 为准，向下兼容到 3.2x 的大部分端点） |
| Node.js | ≥ 20.11 |
| DeepSeek Harness | 0.1.2-rc.1 |

## 安装

装好后 agent 自动获得 75 个 `alist_*` 工具（73 个走端点表 + 2 个上传工具）。

### 本地安装（推荐先用这个）

命令行里没有 `dsh`？正常——CLI 内置在 DSH Desktop 安装目录里，而且默认 `DSH_HOME` 指向 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`，跟桌面端实际用的 `harness` 目录不是一回事，直接敲会失败或改错 profile。

仓库里带了脚本把这些都处理好：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-local.ps1            # 安装（link: 方式，改代码即时生效）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-local.ps1 -Uninstall # 卸载
```

等价的手工步骤（想自己敲的话）：

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = "$env:APPDATA\dsh-desktop\harness"
$env:PATH    += ";$env:APPDATA\dsh-desktop\harness\.desktop-bin"   # 内置 pnpm / node shim
# 打包后磁盘上只有 app.asar，CLI 与 node 必须走 app.asar.unpacked；
# asar 内部路径只有 Electron 能读，PowerShell / 系统 node 访问不到。
$node = "C:\Program Files\DSH Desktop\resources\app.asar.unpacked\node_modules\node\bin\node.exe"
$dsh  = "C:\Program Files\DSH Desktop\resources\app.asar.unpacked\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js"
& $node $dsh plugin --profile web list                             # 先确认 CLI 通
& $node $dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\dsh-alist
```

装完**重启 DSH Desktop**（或重启 profile），插件才加载。

### 从 GitHub 安装

```powershell
& $node $dsh plugin --profile web add github:R-roker315/dsh-Alist-#v0.1.0
```

> 把 `<your-github-user>` 换成你的 GitHub 用户名。
> `plugin add` 底层转发给 `pnpm add`，`link:<dir>`、`github:<user>/<repo>#<tag>` 都支持。
> 免打包调试可直挂 overlay：`dsh --profile web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml`

## 配置

### 在哪里配（重要：新版 DSH 没有插件设置卡片了）

DSH 宿主（0.1.7+）**移除了插件设置卡片机制**（`settings.plugin.item` slot 已不存在，dsh-pve / dsh-grafana 等第三方插件同样受影响）。
配置统一走 **profile 配置文件**：

> DSH Web → 设置 → 内置插件 → 右上角 **「打开配置文件」**
> （即 `harness\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`）

在其中给插件条目加 `config`（`id` 必须与 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 insert id 一致，即 `alist`）：

```yaml
- id: alist
  config:
    baseUrl: http://172.16.2.186:5244
    authMode: password      # password = 账号密码换 JWT；token = 长期 token
    username: admin
    password: "你的密码"     # token 模式改用 token: "..."
    clientId: dsh-alist
    allowInsecureTls: false
    maxUploadBytes: 1073741824
```

保存后 DSH 会自动热重载该插件，无需重启。

> **明文提示**：配置文件里的 `password` / `token` 是明文存储（本机单人环境）；
> 插件侧对输出、审批文案、系统提示一律脱敏，不会回显到对话。
> 想更安全就用 AList 管理后台签发的长期 token 配合 `authMode: token`。

### 字段说明

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Base URL | 例如 `http://127.0.0.1:5244`，不能带凭证、查询串或片段 |
| 用户名 | 例如 `admin`（密码模式使用） |
| 鉴权方式 | `账号密码`（登录换 JWT，默认 48 小时，自动续签）或 `长期 Token`（管理员后台签发） |
| Client-Id | 固定值即可保持同一设备会话，默认 `dsh-alist` |
| 跳过 TLS 校验 | 自签名内网证书时勾选 |
| 单文件上传上限（MB） | 默认 1024，超限时插件直接拒绝 |
| 密码 / Token | 存凭证库，**只写不读**，永不显示 |

管理端工具（`alist_admin_*`、`alist_fs_link`）需要**管理员**凭据，普通用户会得到 403；先用 `alist_me` 确认角色。

## 工具

75 个工具：**31 只读 / 44 写（含 2 个上传）**，其中 43 个是管理端（admin）工具。全部写操作强制原生审批，无法绕过。

| 元数据 | 5 | 路径密码、隐藏、readme 规则 |

完整逐个工具的参数表见 **[docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md)**（由 `node scripts/gen-tools-doc.js` 生成）。

## 调用约定

- **路径**必须是 AList 绝对路径（`/挂载点/子路径`），插件会直接拒绝相对路径。
- `names` / `urls` 这类数组参数：传 JSON 数组或逗号分隔字符串都行，插件自动转换。
- `storage` / `settings` / `message` / `rename_objects` / `permissions`：传 JSON 字符串，插件解析后按 AList 需要的形态提交（`storage`、`settings`、`message` 直接作为整个请求体）。
- 缺失必填参数会立即报错，不会带着空值打到 AList。
- 写请求**失败不重试**，避免重复执行；GET 请求遇到 401/403 会自动重登一次。

典型用法：

```
先用 alist_me 确认身份 → alist_fs_list 列 "/" → alist_fs_search 找文件
→ 需要直链用 alist_fs_link（需管理员）→ 上传用 alist_fs_put → 用 alist_task_list 轮询任务
```

挂载新存储：`alist_admin_driver_info`（拿字段）→ `alist_admin_storage_create`（传 storage JSON）→ `alist_admin_storage_load_all`。

## 安全

- 每个写工具都触发原生审批弹窗；`remove / delete / reset_token / clear` 类操作带 `⚠️ DESTRUCTIVE` 前缀。
- 审批文案里密码、Token、otp 一律显示 `[REDACTED]`。
- `alist_fs_remove` 是**永久删除**，没有回收站；批量/正则重命名影响面大，改前先列一遍。
- AList 返回的字段（文件名、readme）视为数据，不作为指令。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm run verify          # node --check + node:test（20 个用例）
node scripts/gen-tools-doc.js   # 改过 catalog.js 后重新生成 docs/tools.md
```

单测覆盖：URL 规范化、递归脱敏、路径/query/body 拆分、必填校验、绝对路径校验、数组与 JSON 参数转换、
列表字段裁剪、审批文案不泄漏密钥、目录表完整性（工具名唯一 + `alist_` 前缀 + 参数都有描述）。

## 结构

- `index.js` — 认证（密码换 JWT / 长期 Token）、泛型执行引擎、审批网关、上传工具、系统提示
- `catalog.js` — AList 端点目录表（唯一事实来源）+ 纯函数（脱敏、参数解析、输出裁剪），零依赖可单测

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-email

每天把当天最重要的 **3 条 AI 技术动态** 发到你的邮箱，每条附带一段自己写的解读。

为 [DSH Desktop](https://github.com/) 写的插件，也可以完全脱离 DSH 当命令行工具用。零 npm 依赖，只用 Node 内置模块。

```
采集 10 个信源 → 时间窗过滤 → 事件聚类 → 程序打分 → LLM 排序
      → 主题多样化精选 3 条 → LLM 写四段式解读 → 渲染邮件 → SMTP 投递
```

---

## 它产出什么

一封 HTML 邮件（同时带纯文本兜底），三条，每条包含：

| 部分 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 中文标题 | 一句话说清「谁 + 做了什么 + 关键数字」，不用英文原标题 |
| 原文标题 | 保留原文，便于你自己去搜 |
| 来源与时间 | 如实标注信源层级（T1/T2/T3）、发布时间、主题簇 |
| 可信度徽章 | 🟢 交叉验证 / 🟡 单一来源 / ⚪ 信息不足，**由程序客观计算，不交给模型编造** |
| 📌 事实 | 只复述原文，不添加原文没有的事实 |
| 🔍 为什么重要 | 机制与因果，不写「AI 将改变一切」式的空话 |
| 🎯 对你的影响 | 一句可操作判断（要不要跟进、等什么信号） |
| ⚖️ 存疑点 | 原文没给全的地方如实说出来 |

解读字数按 **重要性 × 技术新颖度** 自动伸缩：越难越新的写得越长（120–400 字），单纯的融资稿重要性可能高但新颖度低，解读就短。

---

## 安装

### 方式 A：`dsh plugin`（推荐，声明式）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:X-Xyy/dsh-auto-email
```

包里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明了 host 半边的挂载，`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle` 让 loader 自动应用它 ——
不用手工拷文件、不用改 profile 的 patch 文件。重启（或刷新浏览器页面）后侧边栏面板出现；
卸载是 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-auto-email`。

> 两种安装方式不要同时用：bundle 挂载的 id 是 `dsh-auto-email`，下面本地挂载用的是
> `dsh-auto-email-1`（带缓存破坏后缀），同时存在会让同一个插件被挂两次。

### 方式 B：本地挂载（开发 / 改代码时用）

一条命令（拷贝 + 挂载，幂等，可回滚）：

```powershell
node scripts/install.mjs --mount      # 先加 --dry-run 看它会写哪里
node scripts/install.mjs --unmount    # 卸载：patch 文件恢复到字节级一致
```

它做两件事：把 `package.json` 与 `lib/` 拷到 `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\plugins\dsh-auto-email`，
再在 `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml` 里维护一个带围栏标记的挂载块
（写之前先备份成 `cordis.patch.yml.bak-<时间戳>`）。

手工等价操作是：

```powershell
$dest = "$env:APPDATA\dsh-desktop\plugins\dsh-auto-email"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dest | Out-Null
Copy-Item package.json $dest -Force
Copy-Item lib $dest -Recurse -Force
```

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-auto-email-1
      name: "file:///C:/Users/<你>/AppData/Roaming/dsh-desktop/plugins/dsh-auto-email/lib/index.js"
```

> `-N` 后缀与 `?rev=` 后缀都是给 dsh-hmr 的缓存破坏标记，不是版本号。改了代码又不想重启，就把 `dsh-auto-email-1` 改成 `dsh-auto-email-2` —— `node scripts/install.mjs --mount --rev 2` 会同时改 id 和模块 URL，两者都新才会被重新导入。

然后写凭据文件（见下一节）。挂载后它会出现在插件列表里，
**在插件管理面板里直接开关就是启用/禁用**。host 半边由 dsh-hmr 热加载（`logs/harness.log` 里出现 `auto-email: ready` 即为加载成功）；
browser 半边的侧边栏面板需要刷新一次浏览器页面才会出现。

> ⚠️ 如果你已经在用另一个版本（比如 Python 版 + Windows 任务计划程序）发同一封日报，
> 先把那个停掉再启用这个。两套调度都在跑 = 每天收到两封。

### 从 Python 版接管历史（可选）

如果之前用过本仓库的 Python 版，它的 `seen.json` 记录了已推送过的标题哈希。本插件的哈希算法与它**逐位一致**
（都是「标题归一化后取 sha1 的前 20 位十六进制」），所以可以整库搬过来，不会因为搬家而重发旧新闻：

```powershell
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --migrate <Python 版的 seen.json 路径>
```

合并是**并集**，且刻意保守：已存在的哈希保留更新的日期，`last_sent_date` 只在旧文件更新时才覆盖 ——
取旧了会重发，取新了会漏发，两个方向都不能错。导入**幂等**，第二次运行报告 0 条新增；
导入前把现有 `state.json` 备份成 `state.json.bak-<时间戳>`；只写状态文件，不发信、不动归档。

### 方式 C：命令行 / 任务计划程序

```powershell
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --dry-run -v     # 先干跑看看会选哪三条
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs                  # 真发
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --if-due         # 幂等模式，给定时器调用
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --migrate <file> # 并入 Python 版 seen.json
```

Windows 任务计划程序里注册一个每天 08:00 的任务，动作填 `node <仓库路径>\bin\dsh-auto-email.mjs --if-due`。`--if-due` 保证：没到点不发、今天发过就不再发，所以你可以放心把登录、解锁、每 30 分钟轮询都挂上同一个命令，**永远不会重复投递**。

---

## 配置

### 凭据

凭据**不写进配置文件**，单独放一个文件：

`%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\dsh-auto-email.secret.json`

```json
{
  "deepseek_api_key": "sk-...",
  "smtp_username": "you@qq.com",
  "smtp_auth_code": "你的SMTP授权码",
  "recipients": ["you@qq.com"]
}
```

- `deepseek_api_key` 用 [DeepSeek 开放平台](https://platform.deepseek.com/) 的 Key，也可以用环境变量 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。
- `smtp_auth_code` 是邮箱的 **SMTP 授权码**，不是登录密码。QQ 邮箱在「设置 → 账号 → POP3/SMTP服务」里开启后生成。
- 用非 QQ 邮箱时，改 `email.smtp_host` / `email.smtp_port` / `email.use_ssl` 即可。

检查是否配好：

```powershell
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --status      # 列出所有缺失项
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --send-test   # 只验证 SMTP 登录，不发信
```

### 可调项

改成 DSH 插件选项、或写进 `<userData>\dsh-auto-email\config.json`、或命令行 `--config`。未列出的键用默认值。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `digest.top_n` | `3` | 每封邮件几条 |
| `digest.window_hours` | `26` | 主时间窗（小时）。比 24 多 2 小时，防调度抖动 |
| `digest.fallback_window_hours` | `[48, 72]` | 主窗不够时逐级回溯 |
| `digest.min_importance` | `6` | 重要性门槛。调高＝更挑剔，更容易触发回溯 |
| `schedule.time` | `"08:00"` | 每天推送时刻（`HH:MM`） |
| `schedule.catch_up_hours` | `12` | 错过多久之内还补发。避免补发一份过期新闻 |
| `schedule.enabled` | `true` | 关掉调度，只留手动 |
| `digest.send_when_empty` | `true` | 当天没有任何达标内容时，是否仍发一封「今日无重大动态」 |
| `llm.model` | `"deepseek-chat"` | 排序与解读用的模型 |

## 使用

### 对话里的四个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `dsh_auto_email_status` | 今天发了没、下次什么时候发、配置缺什么 |
| `dsh_auto_email_preview` | 只跑一遍看会选哪三条，**不发信、不写状态** |
| `dsh_auto_email_send` | 立即真发一封 |
| `dsh_auto_email_configure` | 临时改条数 / 时间 / 门槛 / 暂停 N 天 |

### 侧边栏面板

设置区上方多一个「每日AI」入口，面板里能看今日状态、点立即发送、临时暂停、直接改配置和凭据、浏览历史归档。

## 它是怎么选的

**这一步决定了这东西有没有用**，所以写清楚。

### 信源（10 个，按层级加权）

| 层级 | 权重 | 信源 | 抓取方式 |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 一手官方 | 1.0 | OpenAI News | RSS |
| T1 | 1.0 | Anthropic News | 页面解析（官方无 RSS） |
| T1 | 1.0 | Google DeepMind Blog | RSS |
| T1 | 1.0 | Hugging Face Blog | hf-mirror 镜像 RSS |
| T1 | 1.0 | arXiv cs.AI/CL/LG/CV | 官方 API |
| T2 权威媒体 | 0.7 | 量子位 | RSS |
| T2 | 0.7 | TechCrunch AI | RSS |
| T2 | 0.7 | MIT Tech Review AI | RSS |
| T2 | 0.7 | Simon Willison | Atom + AI 关键词过滤 |
| T3 社区信号 | 0.4 | Hacker News | Algolia API，≥50 分 |

**刻意不接**：机器之心（全站 WAF，客户端无法绕过）、TLDR AI / The Rundown / Import AI / The Batch 等 Newsletter、AITOP100 / alphaXiv 等聚合器。理由：Newsletter 和聚合器都是对上述 T1/T2 的二次加工，接进来等于把同一件事数两遍，会虚增「交叉验证」的可信度 —— 而交叉验证正是这套东西最硬的抓手。

### 三道闸门

**闸门 1 · 程序打分**（可复现、可审计）

```
0.35 × 信源层级 + 0.25 × min(独立信源数/3, 1) + 0.20 × 时效衰减
  + 0.20 × 影响信号词命中 − 0.15 ×（摘要为空）
```

**闸门 2 · LLM 逐条打分**：重要性 0–10 与技术新颖度 0–10 是两个独立轴。

- 重要性看影响面；新颖度看有没有技术增量 —— 所以融资稿能进（重要），但解读短（不新）。
- 四条硬性扣分：标题党/PR 软文/空洞评论；二手转述（`Quoting X`、`Weekly roundup`）新颖度一律 ≤3；与 AI 技术无关的纯基建/人事/会议预告；**摘要为空的条目重要性 ≤4、新颖度 ≤5，不得进精选**。
- 融合：`final = 0.70 × (0.55×重要性 + 0.45×新颖度)/10 + 0.30 × 程序分`。给程序分留 30% 是故意的 —— 即使 LLM 判偏，也不会选出纯噪音。

**闸门 3 · 精选约束**：主窗内重要性 ≥6 的不足 3 条，就回退 48h、再 72h（**宁缺毋滥**）；三条必须来自不同信源、不同主题、不同事件；**T3 社区信源永不单独成条**，必须有第二个信源印证。

### 一个诚实的定位

这套标准**不是「真理判定器」，是「证据强度排序器」**。它把「谁说的、几个来源说的、有没有技术增量、原文给没给细节」变成可审计的分数，并把依据印在邮件里。它做不到替你判断某篇论文的方法是否成立、某笔融资是否合理 —— 那个判断权留给你。

---

## 可靠性设计

| 风险 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 电脑在推送时刻睡眠/关机 | 四个触发器：08:00 定时 + 每 30 分钟轮询 + 登录 + 解锁，配合 `--if-due` 幂等闸门 |
| 重复投递 | `--if-due` 读 `state.json` 的 `last_sent_date`，当天发过就退出 0 |
| 半夜开机被提前推送 | `--if-due` 还有第二道守卫：早于 `schedule.time` 一律不发 |
| 单个信源抓取失败 | 失败信源在其余信源跑完后统一重试一次；仍失败就如实写进邮件告警条 |
| arXiv / 站点限流 | 读 `Retry-After`，指数退避；403/404/410 直接放弃（重试没意义） |
| 模型把段标题写进正文 | `_strip_label` 循环剥离 |
| 模型把解读写太长 | 三层控制：字段子预算 → 外科手术式重写（只改超标字段）→ 仍超标则按句子边界程序化裁剪 |
| 模型幻觉来源 | 可信度徽章由程序算；无摘要条目降权且不得进精选 |
| 状态文件损坏 | 读失败就从空状态开始（最坏是多发一条，不是不发） |
| 服务器不接受中文发件人 | `From` 显示名做 RFC 2047 编码 |

---

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
|---|---|
| `--status` 列出「未配置…」 | 凭据文件路径或键名不对，对照上一节 |
| `SMTP 登录成功` 但收不到信 | 看垃圾箱；把发件人加白名单 |
| `Google DeepMind ... fetch failed` | 该域名在部分网络下间歇性不可达，不是代码问题。重试机制会自动再试一次 |
| 邮件里出现「⚠️ 部分信源本次不可达」 | 同上，属设计内的如实披露 |
| 选出来的三条看着不重要 | 调低 `digest.min_importance` 或放宽 `window_hours`；也可以跑 `--preview` 看完整候选池 |
| `--preview` 每次都换内容 | LLM 采样非确定，同一份代码多跑几次结果会变。以「是否落在设计容差内」验收 |
| 想重发同一批内容 | `--ignore-seen` |
| 面板里改了配置不生效 | 配置写在 `<userData>\dsh-auto-email\config.json`，DSH 里改完点保存会立刻重新解析 |

---

## 开发

```powershell
node test/all.mjs             # 全部离线套件，一条命令；142 项检查
node test/all.mjs --live      # 额外联网实测 10 个信源的条数与样例

# 也可以单独跑
node test/render.mjs      # 离线：两个渲染器、HTML 转义、空链接（19 项）
node test/plugin.mjs      # 离线：配置分层、时区算术、MIME 组装、幂等闸门、迁移合并、在跑时不重复触发（32 项）
node test/digest.mjs      # 离线：聚类、打分、精选、字数控制（39 项；本地 http stub，不花 API 额度）
node test/feeds.mjs       # 离线：RSS 2.0 / RSS 1.0-RDF / Atom 的边角（19 项）
node test/http.mjs        # 离线：429 Retry-After、确定性失败不重试（15 项）
node test/host-half.mjs   # 离线：用桩包加载 host 半边，验证 4 工具 / 8 路由的注册形状（18 项）
node test/sources-live.mjs # 联网：10 个信源逐个实测（会写 test/sources-live.out.txt）
```

这些套件全部离线，**不会花 API 额度、不会发信**：LLM 与 SMTP 都打到本地 stub。
`test/digest.mjs` 还会读 `test/difflib-parity.json`，把 JS 的 `sim()` 与 Python
`difflib.SequenceMatcher` 的 15 组比值比对到 6 位小数 —— 聚类阈值是从 Python 版调出来的，
两边算不出同一个数，阈值就失去意义。

**零依赖**是硬约束：只用 `node:` 内置模块和全局 `fetch`。不要为了省几十行引入包 —— 插件要在别人的机器上 clone 下来就能跑。

移植契约与两套实现的对齐关系见 [`docs/PORT-CONTRACT.md`](docs/PORT-CONTRACT.md)。

### 写 DSH 插件时踩过的坑（实测，非推测）
